entry.title: Sun Grown Maduro Lancero
experienceTags: Pairings: Espresso, dark chocolate, rum or cola (projected)
Occasion: Short dark-profile smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Dark-roasted coffee, earth, cocoa, caramel, black licorice and pepper make this darker and sweeter than the standard Sun Grown line while retaining a strong roasted core. The very slim 38 ring keeps the Connecticut Broadleaf prominent and the profile concentrated, with recent exact-vitola reviews reporting an even burn and only slightly firm draw resistance. As a pre-cut half it should preserve the blend’s dark, sweet-spicy character while turning the 7½-inch lancero into a compact 3¾-inch session.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted exact Maduro vitola. The Sun Grown Maduro Lancero scored 90 points in Cigar Aficionado (February 2026) and 91 in December 2023, so Strength and Quality are provisional pending a personal tasting.
productionLines: Made in Estelí, Nicaragua at Rocky Patel’s TAVICUSA factory: Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper over Nicaraguan binder and filler tobaccos.
Purchased as a full lancero and split before lighting into two ~3¾″ × 38 half-sessions.
practicalLines: Buy the full Sun Grown Maduro Lancero at The Index for ~A$47.60 each.
Cut it cleanly in half before lighting: ~A$23.80 per ~3¾″ × 38 session.
This puts the full Sun Grown Maduro blend inside the catalogue’s practical-session target while keeping the narrow-ring Broadleaf concentration intact.
